events.title: Cheniere Energy Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Record LNG Loadings
events.body: LNG expects 2026 consolidated adjusted EBITDA in the range of $7.25-$7.75 billion, revised upward from the previous guidance of $6.75-$7.25 billion.

events.title: PR Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Output, Revenues Miss
events.body: PR expects 2026 net oil production of 190,000-195,000 Bbls/d and total net production of 400,000-430,000 Boe/d.

events.title: Reconnaissance Energy Africa expects Kavango West 1X production testing to begin by month-end
events.body: Reconnaissance Energy Africa Ltd (TSX-V:RECO, OTCQX:RECAF, FRA:0XD) announced that operations in Namibia are advancing toward the start of production testing at the Kavango West 1X well, with testing expected to begin before the end of May.
